title: Automatic jump lists
whyItMatters: Automatic jump lists record files and folders opened through each application, even after the original files are gone.
notes: Custom jump lists (*.customDestinations-ms) are a separate artifact and are not counted here. Files are not parsed. One trace per folder (count, size, 3 sample names) instead of one per file, so the report does not list every recently opened file name.

steps: Open File Explorer, select See more (the three dots) and then Options.
In the Privacy section select Clear; this empties the recent items and jump lists for this account.
Delete any jump list files still in the folder named in the plan. Windows has no setting that lists them.
cleanup.risk: Clears the recent and jump list record for this account. Windows builds new lists as files are opened again.
